# rcs

rcs (R Cloud Storage) stores tabular, geospatial vector and raster data from
R in one store, mainly as Parquet files. A store is kept in one primary
location and any number of secondary ones, local folders or cloud buckets.
Every operation starts from the catalog of the store.

The package is under construction: this version holds the foundations
(catalog schema, simulated data, work counters) and no storage functions yet.

## Installation

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("EBukin/rcs")
```

## Simulated data

The package is developed and tested on simulated data only. The generators
are exported for examples:

```{r}
library(rcs)
rcs_sim_table(5)
```
